title: HTML Table Colspan & Rowspan
text:
HTML
Table Colspan & Rowspan



HTML tables can have cells that span over multiple rows and/or columns.

NAME

APRIL


FIESTA

HTML Table - Colspan

To make a cell span over multiple columns, use the
colspan
attribute:

Note:
The value of the
colspan
attribute represents the number of columns to span.

HTML Table - Rowspan

To make a cell span over multiple rows, use the
rowspan
attribute:

Note:
The value of the
rowspan
attribute represents the number of
rows to span.
